title: Robin
summary_html:
This article is about a character from Ultima VII. For a character from Ultima IX, see Sir Robin.

Robin is a professional gambler who travels in the company of his bodyguards, Battles and Leavell. In Ultima VII, he could be found with his companions, stranded in New Magincia.
